name: fixed-precision-monorepo
description: Monorepo for fixed-precision (class API) and fixed-precision-fp (functional API)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace fixed-precision && npm run build --workspace fixed-precision-fp
scripts.check:exports: npm run exports:gen -- --check && attw --pack packages/core --profile node16 && attw --pack packages/fp --profile node16
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run check:format && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:exports
